name: Seller can create and close a live shopping cart

planSteps.description: Sign in as the configured local TestSprite admin and open the seller dashboard.
Use the seller booking flow to create or open a local test appointment and enter its live-shopping session.
Verify the live session panel shows an active session state and an empty or editable cart.
Add a fake product named TestSprite Sample Shoe priced at 100 USD with quantity 2, then change the quantity and remove/re-add it once.
Verify the cart updates with the product, quantity, subtotal, 7 percent Florida tax, 15 percent commission, and recalculated total.
Verify the session becomes closed and the customer-facing payment stage is the initial 65 percent invoice.
